description: This file contains shell script functions for analyzing filesystem images, including reading magic words, determining filesystem types, and calculating padding sizes.

methods.name: get_magic_word
methods.description: Reads the magic word from a file to identify filesystem type.

methods.name: get_post_padding_word
methods.description: Reads post-padding bytes to help determine filesystem specifics.

methods.name: get_fs_type
methods.description: Determines the filesystem type based on magic bytes.

methods.name: round_up
methods.description: Calculates the smallest multiple of a number greater than or equal to a given value.
